title: Bagpiper-TTS: Natural Language Guided Universal Speech Synthesis
title_zh: Bagpiper-TTS：自然语言引导的通用语音合成
abstract_en: Classical TTS systems typically rely on rigid input formats and predefined metadata slots, limiting their ability to fulfill flexible user requirements. This paper introduces Bagpiper-TTS, a universal speech synthesis system that deals with diverse natural language user requests. Given a natural language prompt, Bagpiper-TTS first reasons over the users' intent to derive a rich caption, i.e., a comprehensive textual blueprint encompassing both transcription and nuanced metadata. Subsequently, this caption guides the synthesis of the target speech. Our model inherently supports a broad spectrum of tasks besides classical TTS applications, including multi-talker, intent-to-speech, role-play synthesis, singing voice synthesis, and more. Experimental results demonstrate that Bagpiper-TTS achieves an 1.7% Word Error Rate (WER) on the Seed-TTS-Eval benchmark and match the performance of dedicated models in both LLM-as-a-judge and human subjective evaluations across multiple applications.
abstract_zh: 传统 TTS 系统通常依赖固定输入格式和预定义元数据槽位，难以满足灵活多样的用户需求。本文提出 Bagpiper-TTS，一个面向自然语言用户请求的通用语音合成系统。给定自然语言 prompt，Bagpiper-TTS 首先推理用户意图，生成包含转写文本与细粒度元数据的丰富 caption，作为语音合成的完整文本蓝图；随后模型依据该 caption 合成目标语音。该系统天然支持除经典 TTS 外的多种任务，包括 multi-talker、intent-to-speech、role-play synthesis、singing voice synthesis 等。实验表明，Bagpiper-TTS 在 Seed-TTS-Eval benchmark 上达到 1.7% WER，并在 LLM-as-a-judge 与人工主观评测中，在多类应用上匹配专用模型性能。
key_points_zh: 提出 Bagpiper-TTS，将用户自然语言请求转化为包含文本转写和细粒度语音属性的 caption，再以此指导语音生成。
突破传统 TTS 对固定格式输入和预设 metadata slots 的依赖，更适合开放式、复杂、个性化的语音合成需求。
统一支持 classical TTS、multi-talker、intent-to-speech、role-play synthesis、singing voice synthesis 等多种任务。
在 Seed-TTS-Eval benchmark 上取得 1.7% WER，显示出较强的可懂度和文本一致性。
在 LLM-as-a-judge 与人工主观评测中，Bagpiper-TTS 在多种应用场景下达到与专用模型相当的表现。

llm_assessment.comment: A capable universal TTS system, but it is largely outside agent harness infrastructure, closed-loop improvement, or production agent governance.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一个有能力的通用语音合成系统，但基本不涉及智能体运行框架、闭环改进或生产级治理。
